summary: Six map-pin pages translated fresh (the "100% duplicate" claim was correctly refuted — every page needed real work). 4,753 visible EN chars → 1,618 CN chars across 6 files, one output file per unit, nothing outside my byte ranges touched. Structural work beyond prose: 1. **Heading anchors.** I derived Foundry's exact anchor algorithm from source (`foundry.mjs:685` `slugify` + `:44691` `slugifyHeading`): CHAR_MAP substitution (`&`→`and`, `’`→`'`) → lowercase → collapse `[\s-]+` to `-` → strip `"` and `'` → truncate 64. Every translated heading carries an explicit `id=` with the English slug, verified programmatically against that algorithm. This matters for `ST-J14`: "Stairway & Elevator" slugs to **`stairway-and-elevator`**, not `stairway-elevator`. 2. **Invisible chars.** `ST-J12`'s basesymbol span is wrapped in NBSPs in the source (`For each\\xa0 \\xa0\\xa0rolled`) — all 3 preserved. `ST-J16` carries 1 stray NBSP inside "a PC removes"; preserved in the analogous slot. 3. **Shared-block identity.** The Sterile Lab block is byte-identical between ST-J11 and ST-J13; the Survey Office block is byte-identical between ST-J15 and ST-J16 (asserted in the gate script, both True). Cross-unit reconciliation: I ran a term census against all 25 sibling `.cn.html` files that had landed. My independent choices **converged** with peers on 站务维护中心 (ST-J27), 工蜂异形 (ST-J10/J21/J23), 储藏室 (ST-J27), 中央区 + 南翼 (ST-J09), 运营主管 (4 units), 阿尔·辛普森 (majority), 通风道 (ST-J01/J19 + glossary), and 东/西地质实验室 pairs perfectly with ST-J19. I changed one label after the census: Landing Pad 起降坪 → **着陆坪**, matching ST-J09 (same journal as the target heading) and the glossary's 着陆舰 family. Scratchpad: generator `…\scratchpad\gen_j11_j16.py`, gate `…\scratchpad\gate_j11_j16.py` (re-runnable).
